trigger_phrase_or_event: Creator asked to make entries less generic, more chaotic/Indian, and improve text hierarchy.

agents.finding: The recognizable mechanic is Hinglish dictionary entry plus lived proof. Preserve the definition format, but make every slide a real scene with a visible object movement.
rules: The key phrase is clear but not oversized; the scene is the main storytelling engine.
Definition is one small translation line beneath the phrase.
Scene proof lives in lower or middle-lower frame.
Each word must be understandable as a relationship behavior if text is hidden.
Avoid textbook pages, app UI, flat quote cards, and random dictionary filler text.

agents.finding: The strongest plan uses a different domestic receipt per word: waiting, migrated objects, search, silent water, budget-dessert, final mixed home evidence.
Both partners must be implicated. Aachu cannot be the only chaos source, and Zuv cannot become a patient saint; the definitions should show mutual ridiculousness and mutual care.
The approved copy is short enough for native integrated text. Use upper-middle negative space, never covering faces or hands; 9:16 needs slightly higher text and more vertical breathing room.
Prompt every slide as illustration-story, not infographic. Include exact text only, tiny top-right brandmark, ivory paper, identity bundle, and hard negative prompt against quote-card design.
Selected system can pass because it is format-clear, scene-first, visually varied, and partner-sendable.

visual_system_candidates.name: Living Dictionary Entries
visual_system_candidates.summary: Each slide is a warm illustrated dictionary entry with the definition integrated above a lived scene.

visual_system_candidates.name: Object Migration Trail
visual_system_candidates.summary: Objects move across the deck like evidence from one definition to another.
visual_system_candidates.why_cut: Good continuity, but too object-first if used alone.

visual_system_candidates.name: Full Dictionary Book World
visual_system_candidates.summary: A literal open dictionary appears on every slide as the main canvas.
visual_system_candidates.why_cut: Risks becoming a prop gimmick and repeating one layout.

why_it_wins: It keeps the format instantly clear while preserving @a.storyof.two's scene-first intimacy. Every word has a drawable couple receipt.
rejected_visual_patterns: Flat definition cards with tiny decorative couple art.
One open book repeated on every slide.
Generic home couch/table scenes with new captions.
Random background dictionary text or fake UI.
